sequences.name: Mystery Pryer
abilities: Spirituality: Enhanced Spirituality upon drinking the potion.
Magic & Divination Arts: Comprehensive but rudimentary understanding of magic, Enchantment, witchcraft, Divination Arts, and Ritualistic Magic.
Eyes of Mystery Prying: Special eyes that can see things normally not visible, peer through Illusions, see truth and reality, discern Spirituality, and examine Astral Bodies.
Knowledge (Knowledge Pursuit): Occasionally chased by knowledge brought to life, imbuing knowledge in random intervals.
Quick Rituals: Can quickly complete Ritualistic Magic without most ritual items.

sequences.name: Melee Scholar
abilities: Physical Enhancement: Improved fitness.
Combat Prying: Mastery of many different styles of martial arts.

sequences.name: Warlock
abilities: Spirituality: Enhanced Spirituality with acute warnings.
Spellcasting: Can create Spells using knowledge and mind; versatile like a traditional fantasy mage.
Knowledge (Witchcraft): Can make potions and better Mystical Items.
Eyes of Mystery Prying: Greatly enhanced; can Pry into mysteries of supernatural powers.

sequences.name: Scrolls Professor
abilities: Scroll Making: Can make scrolls to cast Spells; greatly enhances casting time and combat ability.

sequences.name: Constellations Master
sequences.description: Astrology, Constellations, Stars, and Starlight are all concepts that possess dual meanings with both mystical and real astronomical significance. A Constellations Master has a basic grasp of the mystical aspects of these concepts.
abilities: Starlight Cage: Can create a vast transparent amber that envelops and confines targets.
Star Pillar: Can scatter Stars and merge them into a magnificent pillar of Starlight.
Stellar Self: Can transform into a statue of Starlight particles to slip through fissures.
Starry Sea Shuttle: Can make ships fly through the use of Starlight.
Star Concealment: Can use Stars to Conceal targeted areas and nullify interference.
Star Bridge: Can manifest an illusory Starry bridge.
Star Illumination: Can utilize Stars as a light source.
Eyes of Mystery Prying: Greatly enhanced ability to sense hidden existences.
Spellcasting: Enhanced; can cast some Spells without materials via simple gestures.

sequences.name: Mysticologist
sequences.description: The power of a Mysticologist stems from their extensive knowledge of Mysticism, making them extremely dangerous. In addition, among all Sequence 4 Beyonders, a Mysticologist is the Sequence that encounters danger the easiest.
abilities: Knowledge (Knowledge Pursuit): Higher tolerance for ravings of the Hidden Sage.
Mystical Re-enactment: Core ability; can draw power from mysticism knowledge to create magic or witchcraft.
Eyes of Mystery Prying: Second core ability; can detect more Concealed objects and attributes.
Stellar Guidance: Enhanced Star capabilities.
Mythical Creature Form: Abstract 'black blob' appearing in a higher spatial dimension covered in cracks and eyes.

sequences.name: Clairvoyant
abilities: Mystery Prying: Partial authority over Mystery Prying; can glimpse hidden secrets, knowledge, and Destiny.
Clairvoyance (Prophecy): Can foresee consequences, glimpse best options, and visualize past events.
Mystical Re-enactment: Enhanced; number of uses for certain Spells increased.
Stellar Guidance: Enhanced Star capabilities.
Eyes of Mystery Prying: Can manifest Eyes on parts of their body.

sequences.name: Sage
abilities: Mysticism Knowledge: Authority over Mysticism Knowledge, Deletion, and Revision.
Informatization: Can abstract the body and break down into streams of complex Knowledge.
Education: Small authority over Education; can impart Knowledge in invisible streams of Information.
Mystery Prying: Enhanced Prophecies.
Clairvoyance (Prophecy): Can gain scenes or fragments of the future.
Mystical Re-enactment: Enhanced.
Mythical Creature Form: Informational serpent or eyeball consisting of countless cold, eyelash-less eyes.

sequences.name: Knowledge Emperor
abilities: Knowledge Emperor: Can utilize Information gathered in the Spirit World and influence the Seven Lights.
Mysticism Knowledge: Deeper grasp; can imbue abstract Knowledge with tangible power.
Digital Avatar: Can become a Digital Avatar when in Information/Knowledge flow state.
Education: More authority over Education; can conjure complex Symbols and pour useless Knowledge.
Mystery Prying: Certain degree of Mystery Prying authority; can Pry into Mysteries of True Deities.
Clairvoyance (Prophecy): Can sense events via Clairvoyant abilities.

sequences.name: Hermit
abilities: Knowledge (Information): Symbolism; holds portion of authority leaning toward Mysticism.
Mysticism Knowledge: Embodiment of Mysticism Knowledge; can imbue Digital Objects with power.
Backup: Subordinate authority allowing Revival of Information after Backup.
Hiding: Authority of Hiding; can Hide Information making it impossible to track.
Education: Authority to grant Knowledge to others.
Mystery Prying: Can Pry into any secret, Knowledge, or Mysticism Knowledge.
Spirit World Mentor: Partial authority of the Spirit World.
Divine Kingdom: The World in the Eyes or Digital Heaven, Land of Fairy Tales.
